CENSUS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance
further to amend the Census Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I
4th October, 1997]
No.F.2(I)/97-Pub., dated
4-10-1997.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) The Ordinance may be called the Census (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1997,
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13, Ordinance X of 1959

ORDINANCE L OF 1997
ORDINANCE L OF
1997
CENSUS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance
further to amend the Census Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I
4th October, 1997]
No.F.2(I)/97-Pub., dated
4-10-1997.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 13,
Ordinance X of 1959.--In the Census Ordinance, 1959 (X of 1959), in section
13, for the words "one month" and "one thousand" the words
"six months" and "fifteen thousand" shall be substituted,
respectively.
